name: gdbm
description: The GDBM package contains the GNU Database Manager. It is a library of database functions that uses extensible hashing and works like the standard UNIX dbm. The library provides primitives for storing key/data pairs, searching and retrieving the data by its key and deleting a key along with its data.

installed_descriptions.name: gdbm_dump
installed_descriptions.description: Dumps a GDBM database to a file

installed_descriptions.name: gdbm_load
installed_descriptions.description: Recreates a GDBM database from a dump file

installed_descriptions.name: gdbmtool
installed_descriptions.description: Tests and modifies a GDBM database

installed_descriptions.name: libgdbm
installed_descriptions.description: Contains functions to manipulate a hashed database

installed_descriptions.name: libgdbm_compat
installed_descriptions.description: Compatibility library containing older DBM functions
